passages.context: The summary identifies first-century Jerusalem's rock-cut family tombs, individual inhumation followed in some cases by later bone collection, the expense and upper-class concentration of rock-cut tombs, and lower-class trench or cist graves. It does not establish a universal Jewish burial sequence or broad regional uniformity.
